verdict.rationale:
Unstructured supports table detection and can render tables as HTML, and its structured-data-extractor lets a user define a target JSON schema so extracted values map to typed fields for downstream use — both plausible paths to loading data into a database. However there is no evidence of typed row/column output specifically for tables (only HTML representation), no schema validation, and no worked example showing a clean DB-ready JSON row output without manual reshaping.

missing for 10: typed table-to-row/column JSON output (not just HTML), explicit schema validation/type coercion for tables, an end-to-end example loading extracted table data into a database.
